Soft pieces

Vegetable bulgur

Zöldséges bulgur

8 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Offer it warm and soft enough to squash. Mash it for a baby who is not chewing yet.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g fine bulgur (wheat)
  • 1 medium carrot (about 80 g, finely diced)
  • 1 small parsley root or parsnip (about 60 g, finely diced)
  • 1 medium ripe tomato (chopped)
  • 60 g peas (frozen, to be crushed)
  • 300 ml water (plain, no stock)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (stirred in at the end)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Dice the carrot and the parsley root or parsnip, and chop the tomato.
  2. Simmer the vegetables in the water until very soft, about 15 minutes.
  3. Stir in the bulgur and the peas and cook until the bulgur is soft and the liquid is absorbed.
  4. Crush the peas, then stir in the olive oil.
  5. Mash the serving for a baby who is not yet chewing, and check that every piece squashes.

Adjusted

This grain pot is often held back until 9 or 10 months, and it is sometimes cooked in salty stock. Whole peas are also awkward if a baby is only just starting to chew.

Cook the bulgur and vegetables in plain water until they squash easily, and crush the peas. Offer it from 8 months, and mash the serving for a baby who is not chewing yet.
